decisions.reason: The LHD loader line sits in the firm's core underground mining competence and shares engineering, parts and service with the rest of the range, so keeping the option open costs little while demand from mining and tunnelling remains uncertain but plausible.
The construction site dumper reuses the firm's vehicle know-how at low incremental cost, and the missing website data reveals nothing decisive against it, so the option stays open.

The inclined furniture lift line was presented on its own page and serves a steady niche in moving and removal work with simple, low-cost production, so continuing it is cheap while its value is still being revealed.
Building material inclined lifts fit the firm's lifting and construction applications and share components with the furniture lifts, so keeping this option open costs little.
The truck-mounted variant is a somewhat costlier, more uncertain extension of the lift family, but it shares its technology base and there is no evidence yet of failure, so it is kept for now.
